requirements.evidence: All four routes and the contract are present: pairing plus the JWT claims (app/Actions/PairTotem.php:75-83), the six-digit format check (app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemAuthController.php:17), entity/queue resolution (app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemApiController.php:21-36), backend-owned priorities (app/Enums/TicketPriority.php:13-34), ticket issuance through IssueTicket with the totem channel (app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemTicketController.php:44), the 10/min and 30/min throttles (routes/api.php:10,18), and CORS preflight handling (app/Http/Middleware/TotemCors.php:28-45). The data model, factories, command, config, .env.example and phpunit pins also match the task, and entity_suspended is never emitted.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes use actions (app/Actions/PairTotem.php, app/Actions/OpenTotemPairingWindow.php), issuance reuses IssueTicket, fillable attributes are deliberate (app/Models/TotemPreset.php:12-20), migrations are reversible (database/migrations/2026_10_29_061327_create_totem_presets_table.php:30), and the CHANGELOG plus all required docs were updated, including the proposal-to-implemented status (docs/api/totem.md:13). One drift: docs/api/totem.md:191 says a queue description is always null, while app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemQueueController.php:38-40 returns labels_i18n['description'].

security.evidence: HS256 only with hash_equals and explicit exp enforcement (app/Support/TotemJwt.php:51-64); the middleware rejects missing/invalid/expired tokens, inactive totem or preset and entity mismatch (app/Http/Middleware/AuthenticateTotem.php:45-56) and computes the live scope intersection (app/Http/Middleware/AuthenticateTotem.php:58-68); queue lookup is entity-scoped (app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemApiController.php:29-36); CORS is an anchored localhost/127.0.0.1 allow-list with no credentials (app/Http/Middleware/TotemCors.php:47-60); audit entries never log the code (app/Actions/PairTotem.php:119-127).

tests.evidence: Feature tests cover pairing success/failure, single-use codes and throttling (tests/Feature/Totem/TotemAuthTest.php:120,135), every middleware rejection plus the live scope shrink (tests/Feature/Totem/TotemAuthenticationTest.php:44,112), CORS preflight and denial (tests/Feature/Totem/TotemCorsTest.php:12,32), the command, queue listing, priorities, ticket issuance including its rate limit (tests/Feature/Totem/TotemTicketTest.php:116), and the schema/factories/relations. No existing test is weakened or removed.

simplicity.evidence: The change reuses IssueTicket and a small shared controller base instead of adding a service or repository layer, and the JWT code is the minimum needed. Minor duplication remains: the queue 404/403/inactive-422 block is repeated in app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemPriorityController.php:19-31 and app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemTicketController.php:24-34, and app/Actions/PairTotem.php:95-96 returns totem/preset entries no caller uses.

readability.evidence: Methods are small and well named with useful PHPDoc (app/Http/Middleware/AuthenticateTotem.php:20-80, app/Actions/PairTotem.php:26-100); controllers share a readable base class, rejection reasons are isolated in rejectionReason(), and there is no debug output or dead branch. The only dense spot is the uniqueness do/while at app/Actions/OpenTotemPairingWindow.php:22-27.

scope.evidence: The diff is confined to the totem slice: migrations, models, factories, actions, middleware, controllers, routes and tests, plus the required docs (docs/api/totem.md, docs/database-schema.md, docs/architecture.md) and the CHANGELOG/docs-index updates the docs-freshness convention asks for. No unrelated refactors or out-of-scope features (billing, refresh tokens, revocation lists, operator UI) were added.

issues.explanation: The doc says a queue `description` is always null until operators can set per-queue descriptions, but TotemQueueController returns labels_i18n['description'] (app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemQueueController.php:38-40) and the queues test asserts a non-null value, so the documented contract and the implementation disagree.

The queue-not-found, out-of-scope and inactive-queue response sequence is duplicated in TotemPriorityController.php:19-31 and TotemTicketController.php:24-34; a shared helper on the existing TotemApiController base would remove the copy.
PairTotem returns 'totem' and 'preset' entries that TotemAuthController never reads, so the action's return contract carries dead data.
The 'missing key' dataset row passes [null], identical to the 'null' row, so a request that omits the code field entirely is not actually exercised.

review.summary: Implements the totem BFF end to end: schema/models/factories, the pairing command and endpoint, an HS256 JWT, middleware with a live preset-queue scope intersection, the three data endpoints reusing IssueTicket, throttling, CORS and the required documentation. The change is complete and well tested; the reasons for 4 rather than 5 are a docs/code disagreement about queue descriptions plus small duplication and dead return data, not functional defects.
